items.title: Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 eyewear campaign with Samuel Watson shot by Mark Seliger
items.summary: Fashion editorial covers Gucci's minimalist Fall/Winter 2026 eyewear campaign featuring model Samuel Watson in two looks (optical frames with a checked blazer; sunglasses with a leather shirt jacket), photographed by Mark Seliger. Watson's second Gucci campaign of the year, following the Monte Carlo activation. Standard brand-marketing activation coverage, not independent editorial judgment.

items.title: Kering names Sabina Belli president of Kering Italia, effective September 15
items.summary: Trade press reports Kering appointed Sabina Belli (Pomellato CEO since 2015, ex-L'Oreal Luxe/LVMH/Bulgari) as president of Kering's Italian operations effective Sept 15, reporting directly to CEO Luca de Meo; she keeps leading the Kering Accademia per le Eccellenze craftsmanship initiative. Role covers institutional relations with Italian authorities and craft associations across all Kering maisons including Gucci -- corporate-governance signal rather than Gucci-specific news, included as directly relevant group-level context feeding into Gucci's Italy operations.

items.title: Kering group strike in Florence/Scandicci over layoffs tied to ReconKering restructuring
items.summary: Regional Tuscan daily covers union mobilization (Filctem Cgil, Femca Cisl, Uiltec Uil) against Kering's ReconKering restructuring plan, with roughly 2,000 workers marching in Scandicci near Florence -- Gucci's historic manufacturing heartland -- protesting job cuts announced at sister brand Alexander McQueen and fearing wider fallout across the group's Italian production base including Gucci-linked ateliers. Older labor story (May 2026) resurfaced here as critical-angle context on the human cost of Gucci's cost-cutting turnaround; flagged as outside the 14-day freshness window and included only for background, not counted toward buzz recency.

items.title: Trustpilot reviews of gucci.com continue to skew negative on service, repairs and quality
items.summary: Rolling consumer-review feed continues to show a heavy cluster of complaints about slow after-sales repairs, unexpected repair fees, and craftsmanship defects (loose stitching, hardware wear) surfacing shortly after purchase. Independent, non-brand-owned critical-angle channel included per anti-bias mandate; exact per-review dates and helpful-vote counts not exposed in the aggregate view, left null.

items.title: PurseForum thread on Gucci quality draws split opinions between vintage craftsmanship and newer pieces
items.summary: Active collector-community thread where members compare construction quality of current-season Gucci leather goods against vintage/Tom Ford-era pieces, with several posters noting inconsistent stitching and coated-canvas peeling on recently purchased items versus praise for older archive pieces. Genuine unfiltered community signal (not brand-owned) surfaced directly via community search; page access limits prevented confirming exact reply/view counts, left null.

items.title: Resale analysis: Gucci handbags retain roughly 30-45% of retail, trailing Chanel/Hermes/LV
items.summary: Independent resale-market blog (verification_required tier per policy -- retailer-adjacent, cross-checked against Vestiaire Collective's 2025 ranking where Gucci placed fourth among top resale-value luxury brands) reports many current-season Gucci bags that retailed near $2,000 now trade at $600-900 secondhand, while legacy Tom Ford-era and archive pieces hold value markedly better than trend-driven Demna-era drops.
